name: AVEA
note: Official supplier of the Germany SailGP Team (sailgp.com team page, confirmed 2026-10-03). The AVEA brand belongs to AVEA Life AG, Zug (its own about page). But AVEA was venture-built and funded by Maximon, the Zug longevity company builder and AVEA's lead investor ('AVEA was the very first venture we founded with Maximon' - longevity.technology, 4 Jul 2023; seed funding of $5m led by Maximon), and Maximon's CHF 100m Longevity Co-Investment Fund, open to outside investors, also invested in AVEA (startupticker.ch, 7 Oct 2021). AVEA Life AG's shareholders and any controlling holder are not publicly identified, so the sponsorship is left unrated.
